findings: No discrepancy in core numeric results, units or quantity labels found among the completed follow-up answers in this authored set.
Structured rope and clarification answers differ in wording from the full-history answers but give the same correct core results.
The structured long-history arm asks for the evicted original conditions, rather than guessing an old result.
One long-history setup question about currency conversion is refused in every arm; it is not a scored follow-up and not a service error.

All three negative follow-ups stop in every arm, but some requests for missing provenance are worded as clarification rather than a direct evidence refusal. This does not establish ideal refusal wording.
The comparison does not establish support for every sentence or citation, or robustness to a previously accepted incorrect answer contaminating future memory.
limits: Same model family generates and judges. Ragas match=1 plus keyword/scope checks is a development success criterion, not independent human accuracy. Three negative examples per arm cannot verify a production error rate <=5%.
